title: PET-184 retry-budget ledger (attempts.json)
description: <REPORT_DIR>/attempts.json. The authoritative retry counter, keyed <area>.<sub-probe> (or sweep.N). Written at classification time by Add-AttemptRecord in dispatch.ps1 and read before every dispatch via Get-AttemptsSpent; the marker's retriesSpent is a convenience copy for the in-flight case only. A whole-area dispatch charges every key in its units list; a resplit or requote part inherits its parent sub-probe's spent count because it records under the same key -- that inheritance is the sole termination guarantee for the rule-4 resplit loop. The literal 'all' is a stem token, never a ledger key: the writer refuses it and propertyNames below rejects it. An unparseable ledger is halt-and-surface, never a fresh start (a silently reset budget un-terminates the loop). This file is the single authority for the ledger's shape; the spec references it and does not restate it.

spent.description: Retries consumed against this key. Decision 4: at most 2, then the sub-probe is BLOCKED.

attempts.description: Per-dispatch audit records under this key, including per-part attempts of a split. Appended for every classification, charging or not.

stem.description: The dispatch stem; encodes the part identity for a split.

class.description: The Decision 4 class this dispatch resolved to.

rule.description: The Decision 4 rule (or resume pre-classification) that fired.

charged.description: true only when the class consumes the retry budget (Test-ChargesRetry: INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE, TRUNCATED_OR_MALFORMED, UNGROUNDED_RESPONSE).
